behavior.explanation: No: on the source-visible service path, an ordinary space member may not remove a different member. DeleteSpaceMember resolves the authenticated caller and the selected target membership, compares caller and target, and requires requireSpaceAdministrator when they differ; that helper accepts only an exact SpaceMemberRoleAdmin membership and otherwise returns PermissionDenied. When caller and target are the same user, the administrator check is skipped and the deletion is attempted, so the visible self-removal path differs from the different-member path.

branches.explanation: The different-user branch invokes requireSpaceAdministrator on the caller membership. That helper rejects a nil membership or any role other than SpaceMemberRoleAdmin with PermissionDenied, before the delete effect. Therefore an ordinary member cannot remove a different member on this service path.
